from hermes_tools import terminal
cmd = """python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('solver','programs/task-2b04939f.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def make(n, sep, marks):
 g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
 for x in range(sep,n,sep+1):
  for j in range(n): g[x][j]=8; g[j][x]=8
 for r,c,v in marks: g[r][c]=v
 return g
# Demo: 22x22, 3x3 tiles, separators every 4 cells.
demo=make(22,3,[(1,5,2),(17,5,2),(9,1,3),(9,17,3)])
out=m.transform(demo)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
# Expected path fills: color 2 in tile-row bands 0..4 at tile-col 1;
# color 3 in tile-row band 2 across tile cols 0..4; overlap becomes 6.
for br in range(5):
 for r in range(br*4,min(br*4+3,22)):
  for c in range(4,7): expected[r][c]=2
for bc in range(5):
 for r in range(8,11):
  for c in range(bc*4,min(bc*4+3,22)):
   expected[r][c]=6 if bc==1 else 3
assert out==expected, 'demo mismatch'
test=make(28,4,[(1,12,3),(21,12,3),(6,2,2),(6,22,2),(16,2,2)])
print(json.dumps(m.transform(test),separators=(',',':')))
print('DEMO_REPRODUCED', file=__import__('sys').stderr)
PY"""
r=terminal(cmd, timeout=180)
print(r)
